# Select

> An animated select for React and shadcn, opening with the chosen option over its trigger.

- Docs and live demo: https://eased.dev/components/select?ref=context7
- Source: [src/registry/eased/select/](../../src/registry/eased/select/)
- Installs: `components/eased/select/select.tsx`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `motion`

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn add @eased/select
```

Or by URL:

```bash
npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/select.json
```

Import paths below assume the default `@/components` alias in `components.json`.

A pop-up list for choosing one value (or several) from a short, known set, built on Base UI Select, the Eased floating layer and the overlay core's rows, in the same bordered shell as Input.

## When to use

- Picking from a fixed set of up to about 15 options: a region, a timezone, a member's role.
- Settings forms where the value should read like text in a field, not like a button.
- A same-width control per row of a list (a role column), so every row lines up (R102).

## When not to use

- Long lists, or lists people search: use [Combobox](https://eased.dev/components/combobox?ref=context7).
- Two to four options that should all stay visible: use [Segmented](https://eased.dev/components/segmented?ref=context7) or [Radio Group](https://eased.dev/components/radio-group?ref=context7).
- Actions rather than values: use a Dropdown Menu.

## Usage

```tsx example.tsx
import { Field } from "@/components/eased/field/field";
import { Select } from "@/components/eased/select/select";

const regions = [
  { label: "Americas", items: [{ value: "us-east", label: "US East (Virginia)" }, { value: "us-west", label: "US West (Oregon)" }] },
  { label: "Europe", items: [{ value: "eu-west", label: "EU West (Dublin)" }, { value: "eu-central", label: "EU Central (Frankfurt)" }] },
];

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Field label="Data region" name="region">
      <Select items={regions} defaultValue="eu-west" />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

## Examples

### Composed rows

Compose rows when they need more than `items` describes; `SelectItem` takes an `icon` and a `description`.

```tsx
<Select defaultValue="growth" aria-label="Plan">
  <SelectItem value="starter">Starter</SelectItem>
  <SelectItem value="growth" description="$99 a month">Growth</SelectItem>
  <SelectSeparator />
  <SelectGroup label="Annual">
    <SelectItem value="growth-yearly">Growth, yearly</SelectItem>
  </SelectGroup>
</Select>
```

### A role column

Give every row's select the same track so roles start on one x.

```tsx
<ul className={`${rowGrid} [--col:7rem]`}>
  <li className={rowGridRow}>
    <Avatar name="Jonas Lindqvist" />
    <span>Jonas Lindqvist</span>
    <Select items={roles} size="sm" value={role} onValueChange={setRole} aria-label="Role for Jonas Lindqvist" />
  </li>
</ul>
```

## API reference

### Select

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `SelectOption<V>[] \| SelectOptionGroup<V>[]` | | Options, flat or grouped (`{ label, items }`). Groups are separated by a rule. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | | `SelectItem`, `SelectGroup`, `SelectSeparator`, when `items` is not set. |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `V \| V[] \| null` | | Controlled / uncontrolled value (an array with `multiple`). |
| `onValueChange` | `(value, details) => void` | | |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Choose several; the trigger lists them, comma-separated. |
| `placeholder` | `ReactNode` | | Muted text while nothing is chosen. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | 32, 36 or 40px, like Input. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | | Invalid outside a Field; inside one, the field's validity drives it. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `name` | `string` | | Submits the value with a form. |
| `alignItemWithTrigger` | `boolean` | `true` | Open with the chosen row over the trigger. Base UI falls back to a list below on touch or without room. |
| `renderValue` | `(value) => ReactNode` | | Formats the trigger's value. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | | The trigger's name when no label names it. |
| `container` | `HTMLElement \| null` | `document.body` | Portal target. |
| `zIndex` | `number` | `50` | Raise inside a higher layer. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | The shell; set a width here (it fills its container). |
| `popupClassName` | `string` | `""` | The popup. |

`SelectOption<V>` is `{ value, label, icon?, description?, disabled? }`. Every other Base UI `Select.Root` prop passes through (`open`, `onOpenChange`, `required`, `readOnly`, `modal`, `form` …).

### SelectItem, SelectGroup, SelectSeparator

`SelectItem`: `value`, `children`, `label` (typeahead text when children aren't plain text), `icon`, `description`, `disabled`. `SelectGroup`: `label`, `children`. `SelectSeparator`: a full-bleed rule.

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Enter` / `Space` / `↓` / `↑` | Opens the list with the chosen row highlighted. |
| `↓` / `↑` / `Home` / `End` | Moves the highlight. |
| Letters | Typeahead to the next matching row. |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Chooses the highlighted row and closes. |
| `Esc` / `Tab` | Closes without changing the value. |

## Accessibility

- The trigger is a button with `aria-haspopup="listbox"`; it is named by a Field label, `aria-labelledby` or `aria-label`.
- Rows are `option`s in a `listbox`, `aria-selected` on the chosen ones; group labels name their groups.
- Focus moves into the list on open and returns to the trigger on close.
- Inside a Field, the trigger carries the field's description and error, and the shell turns red and shakes once when it becomes invalid.
- Rows are 40px on coarse pointers; the scroll arrows don't render on touch, where the list scrolls natively.

## Motion

With the chosen row over the trigger (Base UI's `data-side="none"`), the popup grows from that row at 0.97 with no travel: `transform-origin` is the row's centre. When it falls back to a list below, it enters 4px down toward the trigger like every Eased listbox. Opacity fades in 150ms on the enter curve while scale rides the snappy spring; the exit fades in 100ms, scales half as far and never overshoots, and because both are transitions a close mid-open reverses. The highlight is one shared-layout fill that glides between rows on the snappy spring; the list is a Motion scroll container (`layoutScroll`), so the glide stays on target while the list scrolls under it. The check draws in on the snappy spring. Reduced motion keeps a 100ms fade and moves the highlight without travel.

## Notes for AI

Pick Select for a short, fixed set of values in a form; pick Combobox when people would rather type. Pass `items` (flat or `{ label, items }` groups) and `defaultValue` or `value`/`onValueChange`; inside a Field, label it with the Field (or `FieldLabel nativeLabel={false} render={<div />}`), otherwise give `aria-label`.

Don't wrap it in another bordered box or put it inside an Input: it is its own shell. Don't add a check, chevron, highlight or scroll handling: the rows, the glide, the scroll arrows and the align-with-trigger positioning are built in.

## Related

- [Combobox](https://eased.dev/components/combobox?ref=context7): the same rows with a text filter, chips for several values.
- [Input](https://eased.dev/components/input?ref=context7): the shell this matches.
- [Segmented](https://eased.dev/components/segmented?ref=context7): two to four options, all visible.
